research_note: Cashfree introduced a prepaid wallet intended for authorized AI-agent bill payments with user-defined spending controls. Avoid implying unrestricted access to bank accounts or universal availability. Verify production launch details before upload.

segments.title: AI CAN PAY YOUR BILLS?!
segments.caption: A new wallet for authorized AI agents.
segments.speech: Wait... AI can now pay your bills?! India's Cashfree just introduced a wallet designed for AI agents!

segments.title: PREPAID AI WALLET
segments.caption: Load a prepaid balance first.
segments.speech: Here's the idea. You add money to a prepaid wallet, and authorize your AI agent to use it for bill payments.

segments.title: YOU SET THE LIMITS
segments.caption: Controls help limit what an agent can spend.
segments.speech: You set spending rules and limits. The agent doesn't need your underlying bank or card credentials to make those wallet payments.

segments.title: AGENT → WALLET → BILL
segments.caption: Authorized bill payments, not unlimited spending.
segments.speech: So your agent could help handle an eligible bill without getting unrestricted access to your bank account. That's a big distinction!

segments.title: WOULD YOU TRUST AI?
segments.caption: Would you let an agent pay a bill?
segments.speech: Would you trust an AI agent with your money, even with limits? Tell us below! I'm Zeno Sensei. Keep learning with Obscure!
